policy.statement: NoorDeen bundles a transcript or subtitle track only when the project holds a source that it can identify, attribute and lawfully redistribute. No track is inferred from a title, a thumbnail or a machine guess.

sourcesChecked: Local repository scan: no .srt, .vtt, .ass or .sbv files and no transcript JSON/XML files exist under public/.
Internet Archive item DrIsrar_BuQ_HD-Format: metadata lists 930 files; the only text files are five Tanzeem guideline .txt documents, not lecture transcripts. No subtitle files are listed.

Catalog records: all 399 records contain titles, series, episode, language, playback type, source URL and, where applicable, media URL or YouTube ID. None contains a description, duration, chapter marker or transcript field.
YouTube caption availability is not asserted. NoorDeen does not download, scrape or redistribute YouTube captions. Users are directed to the official player and its caption controls.
